_why: DSN-20261109-numbers-truth-audit.md §1 (rev 1) aligned by REV 2 (truth sources, current nav pages, no duplicates) and REV 3 (the authority family G1-G3). One row per displayed figure: the surface it is served from (API path + JSON pointer, or runtime artifact + key) and the truth it must agree with. scripts/numbers_truth_audit.py grades each row read-only and emits the findings list M in its LaneRunReceipt@v2 (LQ-1702 consumes M for strikes/heal/ticket/escalation). A row for a route that is not in lib/navConfig.ts fails the CI gate tests/test_numbers_truth_audit_20261109.py.
_codes_note: The closed code set. Every emitted code is validated against this list by the tests; NT_NOT_MEASURED is the only status-bearing code and always means an unreadable side.

session_et._note: the in-session gate for freshness bounds; identical to desk_truth_monitor's display-truth window

quotes._note: REV 2 A: market_quotes WHERE source IN ('alpaca','finviz') OR source LIKE 'refresh:%schwab%'; never yfinance. ticker_prices is NOT a truth source (LQ-1695).

brief._note: the CIO overnight brief the pages read; last_close.session_date is the authoritative session day

coverage._note: Handed verbatim to desk_truth_monitor.held_exit_coverage (REV 2 C: reuse, do not write new coverage SQL). snapshot_stale_after_h 0.25 = broker_stops freshness_sla 10 min with slack; a stale snapshot is NOT_MEASURED, never 'unprotected'.

quote_price._note: REV 2 A. finviz_elite is the label the CIO brief stamps on a Finviz-sourced mark; it is the same provider, not a second source.

broker_stops._note: REV 2 A: the latest stop_lifecycle snapshot is canonical; stop_last_known is a retiring copy and is cross-checked, never truth.

stop_price_basis._note: LQ-20261107-1740 F2: the stop card's price basis is a vocabulary, not a store — 'quote' is an overnight market_quotes mark, 'last_close' is the newest permitted daily bar, as 'last_close:<YYYY-MM-DD>:<feed>'. Both are admitted; anything else is a provenance defect. The feed inside a last_close string belongs to quote_price's allowed_sources; this row grades the basis itself. No age bound is declared yet: the fallback takes the newest permitted bar at any age, so a months-old close is honestly dated but not bounded — open contract question, not a second code path.

quote_price._note: G2. First measured instance (REV 2 A): 625 market_quotes rows written by the retired yfinance provider in 6 h.

positions_store._note: G2 for the positions writer. Empty result is a pass; a provider outside the list is a finding.

authority._note: G1 runs the gate with --json at this code root (the live release's HEAD) each hour; its findings are M entries with fingerprint authority|rule|file.

http._note: AGENTS.md §28.8: no HTTP to :7777 on a weekday inside this window. Inside it the audit reads the served artifacts the API reads; an api-only row is NOT_MEASURED with reason in_window_artifact_only.

policy._quote_fresh_note: Outside the session a quote may be hours old by construction, but not overnight-old: the regular store's last row for the previous session is at most ~2 h behind the close, so a row more than 4 h old (live 2026-11-09: market_quotes_extended's newest ANET bar was 03:58, 14 h old) cannot verify a displayed price and is NOT_MEASURED, never a mismatch.

rows.label: Portfolio total (Home header)
rows._note: REV 2 A: positions_current as_of <= 35 min in session, else NOT_MEASURED. Sum = non-cash broker_market_value + cash rows' dollar balance.

rows.label: Day P&L header vs its account rows
rows._note: DSN §1 'Day P&L header == account rows -> same_figure_everywhere'. The header is TodayPnl@v1 (total_change, null while status UNKNOWN, gap ticket OI-044) and each account row carries stored_row_change; a cent-rounding step is not a defect, a different figure is. A null header beside a summable row set is reported NOT_MEASURED naming the unknown surface, never compared as zero.

rows.label: VIX tile
rows._note: REV 4 (LQ-20261107-2075): the tile shows the NEWEST $VIX print across market_quotes (continuous, source schwab) and market_quotes_extended (index, feed schwab) -- the same relation `lib/market_regime/vix_complex.py` reads, since LQ-1669. REV 2 A's claim that `market_quotes` never carries $VIX is false: on 2026-11-11 it held the 16:15 print the tile served (17.49) while extended's newest $VIX row was a 03:45 overnight print (18.66). Grading against extended alone therefore indicted a correct tile and misdated the truth row (the audit reported the store's bucket clock, 19:00, as the row's own). The audit compares the tile against the newest print by the ROW's own clock across both stores; value <=0.5%, as_of <=15 min in session.

rows.label: 'Unprotected' count on the CIO page
rows._note: The XLV case. Truth = held - working-stop coverage from positions_current x stop_lifecycle, via desk_truth_monitor.held_exit_coverage; a stale stop snapshot is NOT_MEASURED. Money at risk, so P0.

rows.label: Shares per holding
rows._note: REV 2 A: DB is the system of record (positions_current). Exact, P0: a wrong share count is money at risk.

rows.label: Market value per holding
rows._note: The page's stored market value against positions_current, at the same 0.5% band as the price row: the value is price x shares, so any real drift already surfaces on holdings.price, and a band tighter than the price's would report a one-cent quote difference twice (live 2026-11-09: NVDA 23.79 vs 23.76, SCHD 9.01 vs 9.02). LQ-20261107-2086: the served clock is the row's OWN value clock (market_value_as_of, stamped by holdings_export with the positions_sync run the value came from — the producer now republishes that run's broker_market_value instead of carrying a prior export's), falling back to updated_at for rows written before that field existed.

rows.label: Market value == price x shares on the same row
rows._note: A page that contradicts its own row cannot be caught by any store comparison. Live 2026-11-09: SKYD served price 8.70 with value 8,550 (built from a stale price field of 8.55) and SRNE served 0.2954 with a $0.30 value. Tolerance 0.5% so a broker's own rounding is not a defect.

rows.label: Price per holding

served_from._display_source_note: The displayed current_price is an alias of canonical_mark; canonical_mark_source names WHERE it came from (finviz/finviz_elite = a regular-session mark), and the row's quote_source/quote_session describe the separate, before-close quote_price. Grading the mark against the extended store compared a regular-session close to an after-hours print (live 2026-11-09: two NT_PRICE_MISMATCH findings with one side stamped at the 16:30 close and the other at an 18:38 extended print). The mapping only names the store that can grade each display source; an unmapped display source is still graded and still labelled, and a stale regular store is NOT_MEASURED, never a pass.
served_from._unquotable_note: LQ-1745: market_quotes/market_quotes_extended are quote feeds for traded instruments; a mutual fund's NAV is administered, not quoted, so a quote row for the symbol (fresh, stale or retired) is not the displayed figure's truth. When such a row exists only as a retired provider, the figure is NOT_MEASURED with reason not_a_quoted_instrument -- never a MISMATCH whose truth side is null. Listed by instrument class, not by symbol; the REV 2 A retired-provider FAIL still binds for every class not named here.

rows._note: REV 2 A + REV 3 G3: the displayed price is graded against the store the row's own `quote_source` names (market_quotes or market_quotes_extended). Never yfinance: a price whose only row is a retired provider is a FAIL, and a price whose own source says 'unavailable' is a provenance defect (NT_QUOTE_SOURCE) even when some other store holds a number. The page moved to `market_quotes_extended` for extended-hours names on 2026-11-09, so a single fixed store graded correct prices wrong. `current_price` precedes `price`: inside holdings.json `price` is the broker's own stale mark (live 2026-11-09: SKYD price 8.59 vs current_price 8.70; SRNE 0.0003 vs 0.2954) while `current_price` is the repriced figure the API republishes as its own `price` -- grading the stale field reported two defects the page does not show.

rows.label: Stop price per row
rows._note: The /portfolio stop column is served by /api/v2/portfolio/holdings, which merges stop_last_known into each row (cio_truth.holdings_payload) — the retiring copy, not the canonical snapshot. Inside the 04:00-16:15 ET window this row is NOT_MEASURED (in_window_artifact_only); outside it the served stop is graded against stop_lifecycle. A row whose served own `stop_source` is not `broker_resting` (e.g. `planned`: the CIO's recommended stop, live 2026-11-09 on AMANX 63.66) is not a broker fact and has no stop_lifecycle truth; the page states its own provenance, so the row is skipped rather than graded against a stop that does not exist.

rows.label: Stop state per row (working / filled / none)
rows._note: The /portfolio stop column is served by /api/v2/portfolio/holdings, which merges stop_last_known into each row (cio_truth.holdings_payload) — the retiring copy, not the canonical snapshot. Inside the 04:00-16:15 ET window this row is NOT_MEASURED (in_window_artifact_only); outside it the served stop is graded against stop_lifecycle.

rows.label: Stop quantity per row
rows._note: The /portfolio stop column is served by /api/v2/portfolio/holdings, which merges stop_last_known into each row (cio_truth.holdings_payload) — the retiring copy, not the canonical snapshot. Inside the 04:00-16:15 ET window this row is NOT_MEASURED (in_window_artifact_only); outside it the served stop is graded against stop_lifecycle. The truth is the LIVE row of the newest snapshot (lifecycle working/near_trigger) — a cancelled/replaced/filled sibling is history, not the stop — and no live row means stop_qty 0. A row whose served own `stop_source` is not `broker_resting` (e.g. `planned`: the CIO's recommended stop, live 2026-11-09 on AMANX 63.66) is not a broker fact and has no stop_lifecycle truth; the page states its own provenance, so the row is skipped rather than graded against a stop that does not exist.

rows.label: stop_lifecycle vs its retiring stop_last_known copy
rows._note: REV 2 A: the two disagreeing is itself a P1 finding. stop_last_known is write-only and retiring (config/data_source_authority.json broker_stops.derived_copies); it is never truth.

rows.label: Stop advice: stop now, per row
Stop advice: stop quantity, per row
Stop advice: the price basis behind each level
rows._note: LQ-20261107-1740 F2: 'quote' is an overnight market_quotes mark; 'last_close:<YYYY-MM-DD>:<feed>' is the newest permitted daily bar, never yfinance. A stop row with no price has no basis and is skipped, not reported unreadable. The row grades the field the card's reason now repeats (F1); the age bound on a last_close fallback is the open question recorded on the domain.

rows.label: Briefed holding: which provider marked it
rows._note: G3: a figure served from a non-authoritative or retired provider FAILS even when the number happens to match.

rows.label: Stop card: the session day it names
rows._note: The 'Friday' label: the weekday the card names ('Mon close') must be the weekday of brief.last_close.session_date, and the card's own session_date must agree with it.
